iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

WEBSSO::disable
       Forwards a request without doing SSO processing on it.

SYNOPSIS
       WEBSSO::disable

DESCRIPTION
       This command causes APM to forward a request without doing SSO processing on it. If APM receives HTTP 401 response from
       server, 401 response is forwarded to the end user. The scope of this iRule command is per HTTP request. Admin needs to
       execute it for each HTTP request.

       Syntax

       WEBSSO::disable

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ACCESS_ACL_ALLOWED, HTTP_REQUEST, HTTP_REQUEST_DATA

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.2.1 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
